messages.title: New BIO study pack from Scholz's actual lecture slides
messages.body:
Dr. Scholz posted her Week 2 lecture deck today (Chapter 2: atoms, electrons, the periodic table). Checking back, her Week 1 decks from 8/25 and 8/27 had never been turned into study material either.

That matters, because your existing BIO Unit 1 pack was built from the syllabus objective list, and her slides cover a lot the objective list never names: deductive vs. inductive reasoning, Pasteur's swan-neck experiment, reductionism and emergent properties, basic vs. applied research, the Darwin/Malthus chain, homologous vs. analogous structures, and the whole atomic-theory history from Aristotle to Dalton to Mendeleev. Slide 19 of her 8/25 deck is labeled "sample exam questions," so this is exam material.

- bio110-unit1-lectures-pack.md - NotebookLM source. Run an Audio Overview on this for the drive tomorrow; sections 2, 3 and 5 listen best.
- bio110-unit1-lectures-study-guide.md - checklist, 8 diagrams to draw cold, and the 5 traps she planted in the slides.
- bio110-unit1-lectures-cards.txt - 89 Anki cards.

This is for BIO Unit 1: take-home part (50 pts) posts Tue 9/8, in-person part (50 pts) Thu 9/17, review session in class Tue 9/15.

Keep the older bio110-unit1-* files too. They cover the macromolecules block, which her lectures haven't reached yet.
